response: No, approved doctors and medical referees in the UK may not always agree when assessing a seafarer's fitness. However, they are expected to follow the same guidelines and standards, such as those set out by the Maritime and Coastguard Agency (MCA) and the World Health Organization (WHO). If there is a disagreement, the MCA may become involved to resolve the issue and ensure that the seafarer meets the required medical standards for fitness to work at sea.
